messages:
anya: quick heads-up, ran a short smoke of a new speculative pipeline (we're calling it 'samplecraft') on llama4t-13b-q4; saw ~1.8x tokens/sec but some longform quality wobble.
matt: config paste?
anya: ```\nmodel: llama4t-13b-q4\nquant: q4_k_mixed\nbatch: 8\nshort_prefix: 32\nspec_stage: 1\nfallback_prob: 0.06\nseed: 42\nwarmup_kv: 128\n```\nused our rerank holdout (500 prompts mixed long/short).
kevin: were the regressions KV boundary related? those are common with prefix truncation.
anya: mostly hallucinated clauses at paragraph breaks, a few early truncations vs baseline.
samira: please upload worst-20 diffs and run a deterministic control (top_k=1) to rule out sampling noise.
anya: diffs uploaded (s3 link). quick summary: 12/20 extra invented clause, 5/20 early cutoffs.
jordan: quant could be shifting tail logits; spec decode might amplify rare-token errors.
matt: propose controls: A) fp16 (no quant) same spec pipeline; B) q4 without speculative. compare paired bootstrap metrics.
kevin: add per-token perplexity delta and avg top-10 entropy; entropy collapse after speculative step = bad sign.
anya: launching 3 jobs now. ETA ~25m. tagging @eng-sre in case of infra spike.
ops-bot: deploy-burst started for jobs [sc-1729918881-a, sc-1729918881-b, sc-1729918881-c], expected 30m.
samira: eval method: paired bootstrap, measure fraction of prompts with factual flips, log tokens where KV index changed.
jordan: also test short_prefix variants (64,128); maybe 32 is too short for long contexts.
anya: added short_prefix=64 to job c.
matt: if fp16 is fine, try PTQ-refine on q4 (calibrate on small set) before abandoning q4+spec.
kevin: note fallback_prob tuning; >0.05 reduces speedups significantly — consider adaptive fallback keyed to entropy window.
anya: results incoming. label this thread 'samplecraft-smoke' for now.
ops-bot: job sc-1729918881-a (fp16-control) completed in 27m. artifacts s3://redwood-sandbox/sc/1729918881/a
anya: pulling artifacts and running diffs.
matt: ping when diff summary ready.
anya: diff summary: fp16 vs q4+samplecraft: 1.9x speed, 0.7% drop paired accept rate (p=0.02), BLEU -0.4 avg concentrated in long prompts.
samira: p=0.02 with 500 prompts is notable. recommend 200 human judgments targeted at factuality/coherence.
jordan: try pref64 + adaptive-fallback and q4+ptq-refine in human batch.
anya: spinning a 200-label human A/B with variants: q4+pref64+adapt, q4+ptq-refine, fp16 baseline.
matt: great work, thanks :thumbsup:
_meta: single slack thread dump for eng-ml; messages chronological, slack-style brevity
